script_text: A seismic shift is hitting your Air sign this week as Uranus demands you shake off the past. On Monday, the Moon squares your ruling Uranus in your 10th House, causing delays. Wednesday brings Mercury sextile Uranus, clearing mental fog and sparking innovative solutions to your work problems. The turning point occurs Thursday when Venus enters your 7th House of Partnerships, trining your Sun to restore love. From Friday through Sunday, the Sun forms a trine to your Mars, fueling your 5th House of Romance. Your financial investments yield surprising returns as Jupiter aligns with your 2nd House of Wealth this week. Thursday is your power day because Venus trines your 7th House of Love, while Monday is worst because the Moon squares Uranus in the 10th House. Trust this cosmic realignment by taking calculated risks in your romantic life today. Follow for daily updates.
